card.name: Article before "history of" in patient risk
card.fires_on: The word "a" (or "family" after "personal or") right before the word "history", mostly in phrases like "patients with a history of" in risk statements.

modes.label: "a" before history
modes.description: The article "a" after "patients with" or "with or without", ahead of "history of" and sometimes "previous" or "prior".
modes.example: Use caution when using in patients with<< a>> prior history of bladder cancer.

modes.label: "family" before history
modes.description: The word "family" after "personal or", ahead of "history of".
modes.example: Risks are increased in patients with a personal or<< family>> history of substance abuse

card.writes: It pushes words that describe having a solid or rich background, such as "有着", "solid" and "rich", which fit a following "history".
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before "history of" when a label talks about patients who have a past condition.
